title: AI Adoption Readiness Check
problem: Teams buy AI licences, but adoption stalls without a plan.
summary: Answer 15 questions across strategy, data, governance, skills and change. Get a readiness score and a 90-day Copilot / Claude rollout roadmap written by Claude.
resumeLine: AI Adoption Readiness Check | Claude API, Next.js, TypeScript | Nov 2026 | github.com/ParthShuklaa/ai-adoption-readiness-check – Built and open-sourced an assessment that scores organisations across 5 AI-readiness dimensions and uses Claude structured outputs to generate a 90-day Microsoft 365 Copilot / Claude rollout roadmap; includes rule-based fallback and unit tests
